Around [[3623 BBY]], [[Alliance Commander]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] undertook a '''mission''' to infiltrate the [[Hidden Chain flagship]] and steal [[Darth Nul's holocron]] to prevent [[Heta Kol]] from creating a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-wielding]] army for Heta to use in her war.

==Prelude==
[[File:Sahar_Kateen_watches_Commander.jpg|thumb|left|Disillussioned with Heta Kol, Sa'har Kateen made a deal with the Alliance Commander.]]
After [[Raid on Kessan's Landing|stopping]] the [[Hidden Chain]] on [[Kessan's Landing]], Sa'har Kateen reached out to the Alliance Commander and explained that Heta had successfully recreated the [[Holocron Machine|machine]] from [[Temple of Nul|Darth Nul's Temple]] on [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] and that Heta Kol believes the machine grants her an army of loyal Force-sensitives. Sa'har reveals her plan to infiltrate a [[Hidden Chain flagship|Hidden Chain command ship]] and retrieve the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], rendering the machine useless. Because the ship Nul's machine was stationed on required a special shuttle to board, Sa'har, having previously overheard her brother, [[Ri'kan Kateen|Ri'kan]], mention that a Hidden Chain team was stuck on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] and proposed stealing their shuttle.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Deseperate Defiance|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref>

Both the Commander and Sa'har separately traveled to Hutta and got caught up in the slave revolt against [[Vobbara Yusinduu]].<ref name="What Bothers Minboosa">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|What Bothers Minboosa|Minboosa District}}</ref> With the Hidden Chain shuttle locked down in Yusinduu's spaceport, the pair were forced to work with the rebel slaves to get to it, killing the Hutt lord in the process.<ref name="Out of the Mire">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Out of the Mire|Minboosa District}}</ref>

==Infiltrating the ship==
As their shuttle set a course for the prison ship, the Commander tried questioning Sa'har, who was distracted by the losses the Hutta rebels sustained, on their infiltration plan. After regaining her composure, she stated they needed to disable the communications onboard the Hidden Chain ship to prevent reinforcements from being called. The Commander then forewarned that once they go through with the plan, word would get back to Heta and Ri'kan that she betrayed them.<ref name="sundering" />

As soon as their shuttle landed in the docking bay, a squad of Hidden Chain soldiers arrived to greet them, only to be taken by surprise by the Commander. The pair then fought their way to the systems access room and attempted to use Sa'har's codes to disable communications, only for the codes to suddenly stop working. Adapting quickly, Sa'har told the Commander to use the maintenance shaft so they could slice the comm channels, enabling her to release every door, before returning to the security console and deactivating the alarms.<ref name="sundering" />

{{GameLS}}
The pair continued to fight their way through the ship, soon reaching the detention block and released all of Heta's prisoners. The prisoners reacted hostilely to Sa'har, identifying her as the one responsible for tearing them from their lives. Fortunately, the Commander managed to convince them they had come to help, before the two help escort the prisoners back to their shuttle, promising to be back for them after they had accomplished their objective.<ref name="sundering" />

The Commander and Sa'har then went back the way they came, fighting past more Hidden Chain soldiers, including one conscript who asked with her dying breath if Sa'har wanted this. Eventually, they found Nul's machine in the reactor room. But before the Commander could take the holocron, they evaded a surprise attack by Ri'kan. Ri'kan then vented his pent up frustrations with Sa'har, accusing her of betrayal and blinding Heta with her "Jedi sorcery" while turning her favor away from him. Sa'har refuted that she gave him everything, turning her back on her beliefs to teach him the Force and to follow his Field Marshal. She pleaded with him to walk away, arguing that he was going to die if he continued to follow Heta, but he shrugged off her pleas and attacked her in a blind rage. One of his swings caused his [[Ri'kan's Vibro-Axe|vibro-axe]] to strike the floor, sending an electrical surge that damaged one of the reactors in the room.<ref name="sundering" />

As a fight ensued between the three, the Commander attempted to make a run for the holocron, only to evade another swing from Ri'kan. His blow struck the floor again, weakening it. As Sa'har blocked a blow meant for the Commander, the floor suddenly gave way, sending the three falling into the reactor room below, where their fight continued. Eventually, an impatient Ri'kan started hacking at the reactor, vowing that his foes won't be leaving the ship, even if he had to destroy it. However, a sudden explosion sent all three of them flying. Ri'kan was defeated and left dangling on the edge of the platform with Sa'har coming to the rescue. The Commander initially torn between the holocron, which had fallen from the machine, and the Kateen siblings, chose to aid Sah'ar. After her brother was back on firm ground, Sa'har quickly used the Force to pull the holocron to her before it was crushed by debris and handed it to the Commander. As Ri'kan recovered, the Commander urged Sa'har to flee, only to witness the Padawan immobilized by her brother. Knowing that getting the holocron to safety matter more than her life, Sa'har telekinetically sealed the doors separating them from the Commander, allowing them to escape. As she collapsed on the floor, she faded in and out of consciousness as her brother roared furiously.<ref name="sundering" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
[[File:Sahar_Kateen_in_Desperate_Defiance.jpg|thumb|right|Sa'har Kateen confronted her brother Ri'kan, leaving both of their fates unknown.]]
With the the damaged to the reactors threatening the ship with destruction, the Commander raced back to the hanger, where the prisoners were waiting, and got everyone on the shuttle and flew out before the prison ship exploded. Once at a safe distance, the Commander made contact with [[Arn Peralun]] and updates them on the captured holocron and the freed slaves that were rescued from the Hidden Chain.<ref name="sundering" />

==Behind the scenes==
During the '''Chains in the Dark''' storyline, if the player chose to save the cooling rods instead of the Hidden Chain's prisoners, [[Petra Nihrum]]'s sister, [[Mina Nihrum|Mina]], would be among the Force-sensitive prisoners.<ref name="Storming the Castle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|Ord Mantell}}</ref> If player chose light side dialogues, Mina would join the escaped prisoners aboard the Commander's stolen shuttle. Any other dialogue, neutral or dark side, leaves her fate unknown.<ref name="sundering" />

The player has the following options when Sa'har pleaded for help in saving Ri'kan:
*If the player chooses the light side dialogue and helps save Ri'kan, Sa'har will immediately save Darth Nul's holocron before it is crushed by debris and hands it to the player, which Ri'kan wakes up to witness. As the player runs for the exit, Ri'kan will immobilizes Sa'har with the Force, forcing her to seal the exit to allow the player to escape. Ri'kan will then stand over a bare conscious Sa'har and roars furiously.
*If the player chooses the neutral dialogue, they will run for the holocron first. But as the player rushes to help Sa'har, a large piece of debris separates them. As the players leaves, believing the Twi'leks to be dead, it is revealed that Sa'har had in fact managed to pull up Ri'kan by herself and the two siblings stare into each other's eyes. 
*If the player chooses the dark side dialogue, they will simply take the holocron and leave. Sa'har will then pull up Ri'kan by herself, narrowly avoiding being crushed by debris, leaving the two siblings to regard each other.<ref name="sundering" />

Imperial players are later contacted by [[Darth Krovos]] regarding both the slaves and Nul's holocron. Krovos requests that the slaves be sent to Korriban to further bolster the number of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the Empire and also that Nul's holocron be sent to the Empire for protection.<ref name="sundering" />
